launch: Fresh systemd --user transient service with --pipe --wait --collect, unique task/attempt label. Use the qualified bwrap candidate only after current namespace/resource tests; no fallback to uncontained execution.
sandbox: bwrap --unshare-all --new-session --die-with-parent --clearenv; read-only exact /profile, executable/stdlib/system-library mounts; empty tmpfs root, new /proc and minimal /dev; writable private /work only. No network interfaces/routes beyond fresh isolated loopback, no host sockets/repo/HOME/keys/config/cache mounted.
ambient_secrets: Construct environment from allowlist, never copy host environment into service. API keys/tokens/proxies/SSH agent/DB URLs unavailable. SDK env-copy thus copies only sandbox env.
admission_tests: Denied TCP/DNS/Unix host socket attempts with constant diagnostic code, no provider traffic.
Synthetic host-home sentinel not readable; outside write denied; private write succeeds.
Timeout and orphan synthetic process killed in claimed cgroup; memory/task caps applied and observer detects truncated output as invalid.
Hash drift in source/deps/driver/emitted file and loader resolution outside allowlist rejected before importing SDK.

Six inode/type/mode/symlink/race/attempt ownership checks and exact mounted-node I/O; roles reopen after exec under Python close_fds=True and normal Node stdio, using constant diagnostic helpers only.
Two-direction raw identity with partial writes, separate stderr and named-control barriers; a known omitted/late/corrupted chunk or false FORWARD_COMMIT must invalidate capture.

FIFO backpressure, missing reader, producer crash, orphan, normal exit, SIGTERM mid-commit and SIGKILL all bounded; cleanup must be witnessed independently. Missing100ms commit deadline invalidates, never passes a result.
Supervisor control cannot be injected into SDK streams, FIFO frame limits observed and unclaimed host sockets remain inaccessible.

observer.location: Host-side supervisor outside target cgroup; code is independent of SDK/fixture and identity bound before use.
observer.events: Monotonic timestamps; case/attempt ID; raw stdout/stderr bytes in separate files; actual pipe data and sidecar wire ledger, framing offsets/directions; byte counts, digests, exit code/signal, PID/startticks/cgroup; structured API results/errors are a separate lane.
observer.transport: Selected named-FIFO topology in transport-topology.json: unmodified-byte adapters inserted via supported executable overrides, separate peer processes and supervisor channels reopened after exec. No extra FD is assumed inherited across SDK Popen/spawn. Raw chunks and actual forward commits are distinct; control never enters SDK stdio.
observer.ordering: No sleep as proof. Peer announces only receipt/output-write milestones; driver announces invocation/cancel/done. Observer confirms pipe bytes, process identity and exit independently. FIN/EOF, request write, SDK return, signal and wait/reap are different events. Complete frames/counters must reconcile with topology END/known termination and host service/cgroup/pipe EOF witnesses. Uncertain signal/commit windows invalidate capture.
observer.assertions: Compare raw frames with selected source obligations plus separate API lane. UUIDs learned from captured initialize/request and reflected by synthetic peer; no uncontrolled frame normalization. Preserve full stdout and stderr even on error; no fabricated zero streams.
observer.negative_power: A control observation with an omitted initialized notification, false terminal assumption, swapped reply ID, changed emitted code, or cancellation misreported as remote stop must be rejected by the respective assertion/admission predicate. These controls are NOT_RUN until actual driver implementation.

cleanup: Supervisor terminates only its identity-bound service/processes, bounded TERM then KILL, waits/reaps all direct descendants or records independent cgroup populated=0 plus service exit. Record every timeout, signal, non-reaped child and escalation. Preserve input/capture/cache; do not delete peer files. Neither SDK.close nor child.killed nor Python cancellation proves cleanup.
outcome: PASS_CLIENT_OBSERVATION only when assertions and separate capture/cleanup completeness pass. Otherwise MISMATCH/INVALID_CAPTURE/INCONCLUSIVE/ADMISSION_FAILED. No official parity receipt is emitted by this profile.
